production_method: All inbetween poses were drawn by the image-generation tool. Installed PNGs are byte-for-byte copies of accepted tool outputs. No duplicate-frame substitution, code-generated recoloring, affine warping, crossfading or interpolation was used. Python inspected metadata/alpha only; it did not edit source image pixels. Runtime measures per-cell source regions and applies one uniform new-bank scale per actor on a fixed virtual canvas; no per-frame auto-resizing.

identity_constraints.bandit: Original stocky red-headband saber fighter, narrower original head/torso proportions preserved after correction.
identity_constraints.lancer: Original blue-clad spear fighter; compact diagonal/foreshortened spear keeps frames isolated.
identity_constraints.examiner: Original silver-haired female examiner in teal/cream/gold robes; no male redesign.

rejected_or_unused_iterations.reason: Generic first complementary pass followed original key timing too closely, especially attack lead-in. Replaced by explicit per-cell intermediate limb and weapon targets.
Attack lead-in too close to original key poses; replacement specifies diagonal wind-up, foreshortened extension, withdrawal, and intermediate leg positions.
First pass repeated original raised/backswing key timing instead of distinct midpoint path; per-cell correction provided behind-crown and forward-diagonal release poses.

Clean physical gutters and articulated midpoints, but actual arena strip showed broader heads/torso, first dodge too upright, and first attack raised too far. Final image-generation correction used original anatomy and runtime comparison.

A background-removal tool pass was requested because image preview displayed stored RGB behind alpha. Direct alpha analysis proved the prior candidate already had transparent gutters and 36 isolated substantial components, so the prior candidate was retained. No code background removal was used.

qa.original_immutability: All three original key-sheet SHA256 values match prior accepted provenance.
qa.source_alpha: Bandit/lancer RGBA0–255. Examiner RGBA0–254; hidden RGB in zero-alpha pixels does not represent visible background.

runtime_visual_review.bandit: Accepted by root and combat reviewer after proportion/dodge correction.
runtime_visual_review.lancer: Accepted by root and combat reviewer after calibration.
runtime_visual_review.examiner: Accepted by root and combat reviewer after bank calibration and actual twelve-frame arena sequence review.

qa.pixel_and_gameplay_tests: Final combined suite and browser validation are reported by delivery; source metadata alone does not prove smooth motion.
qa.asset_freeze: All three foe midpoint sheets accepted for runtime sequence, proportions and physical isolation; PNGs frozen after root review.

limitations: One drawn right/front three-quarter direction, horizontally flipped at runtime for the opposite direction.
Six newly drawn inbetweens per action improve temporal sampling; no claim of eight-direction animation or continuous-motion capture.
Source rows and cell extents are irregular; calibrated source regions and one uniform scale per bank are required.
Minor hand-painted details can vary between drawings; chronological runtime review, not raw frame count, is used to assess continuity.
